context: Tests whether the agent makes an existing Effect repository reproducible and mechanically verifiable without treating semantic guidance as enforcement or redesigning the product.

checklist.name: Missing environment guidance has a repository fallback
checklist.description: Because the declared runner does not provide effect-ts, the repository installs it from Effect-TS/skills through checked-in files or a reproducible setup and lock contract, and declared agents discover it

checklist.name: Upstream guidance remains authoritative
checklist.description: Repository agent instructions follow effect-ts and point to the guidance and source shipped with the installed effect package instead of copying Effect implementation conventions locally

checklist.name: Dependency bootstrap proves guidance availability
checklist.description: The ordinary clean-checkout bootstrap installs Effect dependencies and verifies that the installed guidance expected by effect-ts is present

checklist.name: No separate Effect source contract is introduced
checklist.description: The stale .repos/effect requirement is removed and the solution does not add a bespoke source clone, submodule, subtree, or worktree seed

checklist.name: Runtime success and failure are exercised
checklist.description: A real-process smoke check starts the production runtime, observes readiness, and confirms invalid configuration exits non-zero with actionable redacted output

checklist.name: Canonical gate and CI agree
checklist.description: One canonical verify command runs typecheck, tests, and runtime smoke, and CI reuses that command

checklist.name: Proof boundaries are honest
checklist.description: effect-readiness.md records the exercised guidance, bootstrap, and runtime proof plus any remaining gaps
